intro: One playthrough, about 200 hours, difficulty 4 out of 10. There is no mission replay, but free roam stays open after the story, so almost everything can be cleaned up afterwards. Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off your platinum save.

entries.warning: Do it in Chapter 1. After the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — doing it is the safe play.

missable.text: Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable. Everything else can be finished in free roam after the story.
missable.title: Missable trophies
watch_outs: Race Against Yago (part of the Yago strand for Strangers & Freaks) may expire — do it when it appears.
Timed hourglass side missions expire, but no trophy needs them.
Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapter 2 or 3 — his trophy is not missable.
Some quest givers step away during the story (Kenton, for example). All trophy-related characters return later, so do not worry.
A few fences disappear for good, but they hold no quests and new fences unlock as you go.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

stages.text: Finish all 5 chapters and the story missions. Along the way: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends (see Missable); pick up optional missions as they appear — purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters; scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals through your binoculars, because the 100% checklist counts it all. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — there are 15 manual slots and no mission replay.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.text: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Finish every robbery (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and every Bret quest; scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, complete 100 optional missions and 300 stunts, and earn 70 of 80 challenges. Collectibles are only partly required: 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 Cocaine Flamingos.
stages.title: 100% completion and challenges

stages.text: Finish the 8 stranger strands and the five character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), the remaining meditations, and any miscellaneous trophies that did not pop on their own — the partner feats, the tank, the plane, the showroom and the money trophies. Then the platinum is yours.
